svg.title: The life of a Cloud PC
svg.desc: A Cloud PC with the status Provisioned can follow three paths. An administrator can resize it in Intune: RAM and vCPU can go up or down, disk only up, a license of the new size is needed, and user and disk data are kept. An administrator can reprovision it when its status is Failed or Provisioned: the user is signed out, all data and apps are deleted and a new Cloud PC is built from the current policy. If the old license is removed and no new one is assigned, the Cloud PC goes into a grace period and keeps working for seven days. After seven days, or when the administrator selects Deprovision now, the operating system and data are deleted.
